What if Dumbledore’s “drinking problem” in Harry Potter wasn’t just a running gag… but an actual curse?

Throughout the Harry Potter series, Dumbledore constantly offers people drinks — tea, brandy, wine, mead, butterbeer — and somehow nobody ever seems to drink with him. From Hagrid and Slughorn to the Dursleys and even the Yule Ball, a bizarre pattern quietly follows Albus Dumbledore throughout the entire story.

Today we explore one of the strangest hidden patterns in Harry Potter and the shocking moment the curse may have begun.
